title: PAD SPRINT TOGGLE DEFAULT
why: His 10-25 g-68: Pad defaults to toggle. Watch: click LS once to keep running; stop the stick, aim with LT, fire a shot or run out of breath to end it. Keyboard Shift stays a hold. Saved hand picks stay until the sprint row is clicked.
now: One sprint row gains hold, pad toggle as the default. Saved hold and toggle choices keep their indexes. LOCAL: no linked review.
